info.title: DataHosting SAPI-SK, Peppol Gateway, and Integrator APIs
info.description: Combined snapshot of the published SAPI-SK, Peppol Gateway API v1, and Integrator API OpenAPI documents. Integrator-specific SAPI error schemas are namespaced where the published groups define different schemas under the same component names. Discovery capability is normalized to the ParticipantCapability-or-null union implied by its reference and description because the live declaration is internally inconsistent.

post.summary: Submit a document for Peppol delivery
post.description: Submit a single electronic business document for processing and delivery via the Peppol network. Synchronous acceptance confirms technical receipt by the Access Point only; it does not imply semantic validation, successful Peppol delivery, or legal effect.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key for idempotent document submission. Same key and same payload returns the original response; same key with different payload returns 409 Conflict.

parameters.name: X-Peppol-Participant-Id
parameters.description: Sender's Peppol Participant ID (organization context). Must match metadata.senderParticipantId in the request body.

409.description: Idempotency-Key has already been used with a different request payload

422.description: Document rejected by the Peppol Access Point

post.description: Mark the document as ACKNOWLEDGED. The operation is idempotent: acknowledging an already acknowledged document returns success. This confirms successful handover to the software endpoint.

parameters.name: documentId

SapiError.description: Structured SAPI error object for machine-readable error handling, retry behaviour, and diagnostics.

details.description: Optional field-level or contextual information to aid diagnostics.

retryable.description: Explicit indicator whether the request may be retried without modification.

correlation_id.description: Identifier used for tracing, logging, and support.

SapiErrorResponseEnvelope.description: SAPI error response envelope. All API error responses use this consistent structure.

creationDateTime.description: Document creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

payload.description: Peppol-conformant business document content as UTF-8 UBL XML. Maximum size: 10 MB.

payloadFormat.description: Format of the payload. Fixed to XML in SAPI v1.0.

payloadEncoding.description: Optional character encoding of the payload. Defaults to UTF-8.

checksum.description: Optional SHA-256 checksum calculated over the exact byte representation of the payload, encoded as lowercase hexadecimal.

SapiSendDocumentResponse.description: Send document response. Synchronous acceptance confirms technical receipt only.

providerDocumentId.description: Unique document identifier assigned by the Access Point provider.

status.description: ACCEPTED means technical receipt is confirmed. REJECTED means the document was not accepted.

receivedAt.description: Timestamp when the document was received. Present when status is ACCEPTED.

SapiAcknowledgeResponse.description: Acknowledge response. Confirms successful handover to the software endpoint.

acknowledgedDateTime.description: Timestamp when the document was acknowledged.

grant_type.description: OAuth 2.0 grant type. Must be client_credentials.

scope.description: Optional scope for the access token.

access_token.description: JWT access token for API calls.

SapiReceivedDocumentListResponse.description: Document listing response. Listing does not imply retrieval, processing, or business acceptance.

documents.description: List of document metadata, sorted oldest first.

nextPageToken.description: Opaque cursor token for the next page. Absent when no more pages are available.

SapiReceivedDocumentDetailResponse.description: Document retrieval response. The payload is delivered as received via the Peppol network.

payload.description: Document content as received via the Peppol network.

SapiTokenStatusResponse.description: Access token status and expiration details.

valid.description: Whether the token is currently valid.

client_id.description: Client ID this token belongs to.

issued_at.description: Time when the token was issued.

should_refresh.description: True if the token should be refreshed soon.

refresh_recommended_at.description: Recommended time to refresh the token.

signingSecret.description: Webhook signing secret. Returned only once when the webhook is created.

ValidateDocumentResponse.description: Result of synchronous Peppol document validation.

valid.description: Whether the document passed all validation checks.

receiverParticipantId.description: Receiver participant ID. Required for UBL_XML; derived from SBDH_XML.

payload.description: UTF-8 XML payload. Maximum size per payload: 10 MB.

SendDocumentsRequest.description: Batch outbound document submission request. Maximum HTTP request body size: 100 MB by default; deployments may configure this with app.outbound.send-documents.max-request-size.

documents.description: Documents to submit. Maximum 100 documents per request.

receives.description: True when the participant can receive the requested document.

endpoint.description: Endpoint URL if exposed by discovery.

transportProfile.description: Transport profile, if exposed by discovery.

WebhookUpdateRequest.description: Webhook update request. At least one field should be supplied.

nextPageToken.description: Cursor token for the next page, if present.

ProviderReference.description: Diagnostic reference to the internal provider.

SentDocumentError.description: Safe client-facing failure information for a sent document.

SentDocumentResponse.description: Sent document metadata and processing status.

MessageLevelStatusListResponse.description: Message Level Status responses received for an outbound document.

MessageLevelStatusReason.description: Detailed reason reported in a Message Level Status response.

MessageLevelStatusResponse.description: Message Level Status received for an outbound document.

ParticipantResponse.description: Participant profile and supported document capabilities.

reachable.description: True when a Peppol endpoint was found through discovery.

dic.description: Slovak tax identifier used to derive the participant ID.

verification_token.description: Verification token used for SMP registration.

IntegratorSapiError.description: Structured SAPI error object for machine-readable error handling, retry behaviour, and diagnostics.

details.description: Optional field-level or contextual information to aid diagnostics.

retryable.description: Explicit indicator whether the request may be retried without modification.

correlation_id.description: Identifier used for tracing, logging, and support.

IntegratorSapiErrorResponseEnvelope.description: SAPI error response envelope. All API error responses use this consistent structure.
